description: SYMBOLIC TEMPLATE showing every part of an AAPEF scenario. Not a real network and not derived from NASim or any dataset. Keys starting with '_note' are comments for the reader; the loader ignores unknown keys. Hosts H0..H3: H0 = attacker foothold (initial user), H1 = gateway, H2 = internal server, H3 = target (goal = admin).
_note_hosts: Required, non-empty list. Each host needs a unique 'id'. ip/hostname/os/services are descriptive metadata only: preconditions never read 'services' (use env_facts for that).
_note_topology: Optional list of DIRECTED [from, to] pairs between declared hosts. Checked only through the 'reachable' precondition. It does not grant access and has no notion of service or port.
_note_env_facts: Optional list of static strings. The single source of truth for 'env_fact' preconditions (e.g. 'this host runs the vulnerable thing').
_note_initial_state: Required. 'access' must list EVERY host exactly once with a level in none | user | admin (missing, extra or invalid entries are rejected). 'known' is the set of facts the attacker already knows.
_note_actions: Required, non-empty. Per action: id (unique string), cost (non-negative INTEGER), effects (non-empty list), optional name, preconditions (default empty), evidence (not validated), cve, cvss_override, cvss. Order is significant: it fixes tie-breaking and DFS order.

actions.name: Information gathering (effect: learn only)
actions._note: precondition types: access_at_least + reachable. effect type: learn. No set_access, so recost gives it the fixed discovery cost.

actions.name: Initial access on H1 (precondition types: known + env_fact + reachable)
actions._note: 'cve' links the action to scenarios/cve_catalog.json for `recost`. Keep 'cost' when you want the file loadable as is; drop it for a CVE-source file that is recosted first.

actions.name: Local privilege escalation on H1 (effect: set_access can raise to admin; never lowers)
actions._note: 'cvss_override' replaces part of the vector derived from structure. Do not combine it with 'cve' on the same action.

actions.name: Direct route to the target: one step, higher cost (an alternative path)
Longer route to the target through H2

_note_goal: Required. Only type 'access_at_least' is supported: one host and one level.
